survival.interpretation: Estimated cumulative survival among similar survey profiles, not an individual death date or medical prognosis.

wellness_cards.title: Not currently smoking
wellness_cards.message: You report that you do not currently smoke cigarettes.

wellness_cards.title: Recreational activity
wellness_cards.message: Your logged moderate and vigorous recreation meets the adult aerobic activity minimum of 150 moderate-equivalent minutes per week. Other activity and strength training are not captured here.

wellness_cards.title: Sleep duration
wellness_cards.message: Your usual workday sleep meets the CDC duration recommendation for your age group. Sleep quality is not measured here.

wellness_cards.title: Awake sitting
wellness_cards.message: Your reported sitting time is tracked. Current adult guidance is to move more and sit less; this package does not impose a single daily cutoff.

wellness_cards.title: BMI context
wellness_cards.message: BMI is a screening measure, not a diagnosis or an instruction to gain or lose weight. Consider it alongside other health information.
